handlePreviewClick : undefined } ``` ✓ Preview enabled for **previewable files** (same as own files) **For Shared List View (SharedFileBrowser.tsx, lines 279-292):** ```tsx {}} onDelete={() => {}} onDetails={handleDetailsClick} readOnly onHide={contextShareId ? Now I have the full picture. Here's the diagnosis:

## Root Cause

The test expects a **"Preview"** button in the context menu for a `.txt` file, but the app shows **"Edit"** instead.

- `isPreviewableFile()` only covers images, PDFs, audio, and video — **not text files**
- Text files get `onEdit` (which shows an "Edit" button), not `onPreview`
- The SharedFileBrowser correctly passes `onEdit` for text files (line 445-448) and `onPreview` for image/PDF/audio/video (lines 450-453)
- The test at line 465 calls `charlieContextMenu.clickPreview()`, which looks for `button[role="menuitem"]` with text "Preview" — it never appears for a `.txt` file, so the click waits until the 30s timeout

This is almost certainly from the refactoring that split "Edit" and "Preview" into separate menu items. Previously, text files may have had a "Preview" option; now they only have "Edit" (which opens a read-only text editor for shared files).

## Fix

The test needs to click "Edit" instead of "Preview" for text files. Let me update it.

name: Release Gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  verify-e2e:
    name: Verify E2E Passed
    # Only run on release-please PRs
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Verify E2E tests passed on main
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get the latest commit on main (the base the release PR targets)
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Latest main commit: ${MAIN_SHA}"

          # Web E2E must exist and pass
          E2E_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
            --json headSha,conclusion \
            --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion")

          if [ -z "$E2E_CONCLUSION" ]; then
            echo "::error::No E2E test run found for main (${MAIN_SHA}). E2E must pass before releasing."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$E2E_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION})"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Web E2E: passed"

          # Desktop E2E — block only if it ran and failed
          DESKTOP_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
            --json headSha,conclusion \
            --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion")

          if [ -n "$DESKTOP_CONCLUSION" ] && [ "$DESKTOP_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::Desktop E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${DESKTOP_CONCLUSION})"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$DESKTOP_CONCLUSION" ]; then
            echo "Desktop E2E: no run for this commit (skipped)"
          else
            echo "Desktop E2E: passed"
          fi

          echo "All E2E gates passed — release is safe to merge."

I see the problem clearly. Here's the timeline:

1. A commit is pushed to `main`
2. Two workflows trigger simultaneously:
   - `e2e.yml` (on push to main) — takes several minutes to run
   - `release-please.yml` (on push to main) — runs quickly, creates/updates the release PR
3. When release-please opens/updates the PR, `release-gate.yml` triggers (on `pull_request: opened, synchronize`)
4. `release-gate.yml` checks if the E2E run for the main SHA has completed and passed
5. But E2E is still running! So either `conclusion` is empty/null (no completed run yet) or it hasn't been found


6. The fix is to add a polling mechanism in the release gate that waits for the E2E workflow to finish before checking its status, rather than failing immediately if it's not done yet.

The issue is clear. Here's the race condition:

1. Push to `main` triggers both `e2e.yml` and `release-please.yml` simultaneously
2. Release-please finishes quickly and opens/updates the PR
3. That triggers `release-gate.yml` immediately
4. But the E2E run is still in progress, so the gate finds no completed run and fails

The fix is to have the release gate **poll and wait** for the E2E run to finish instead of checking once and failing. Let me update it.

name: Release Gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  verify-e2e:
    name: Verify E2E Passed
    # Only run on release-please PRs
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Wait for E2E tests and verify they passed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get the latest commit on main (the base the release PR targets)
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Latest main commit: ${MAIN_SHA}"

          # Poll for the Web E2E run to complete (it triggers on the same push)
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=30
          POLL_INTERVAL=30
          echo "Waiting for Web E2E run to complete (polling every ${POLL_INTERVAL}s, max ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts)..."

          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            E2E_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
              --workflow=e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
              --json headSha,conclusion,status \
              --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion")

            if [ -n "$E2E_CONCLUSION" ]; then
              echo "Web E2E completed with conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION}"
              break
            fi

            if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
              echo "::error::Web E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes for main (${MAIN_SHA})."
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
            sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
          done

          if [ "$E2E_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION})"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Web E2E: passed"

          # Desktop E2E — block only if it ran and failed
          DESKTOP_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
            --json headSha,conclusion \
            --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion")

          if [ -n "$DESKTOP_CONCLUSION" ] && [ "$DESKTOP_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::Desktop E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${DESKTOP_CONCLUSION})"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$DESKTOP_CONCLUSION" ]; then
            echo "Desktop E2E: no run for this commit (skipped)"
          else
            echo "Desktop E2E: passed"
          fi

          echo "All E2E gates passed — release is safe to merge."

git add .github/workflows/release-gate.yml && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(ci): poll for E2E completion in release gate instead of failing immediately

The release-please PR opens before E2E tests finish on main, causing
the release gate to fail with "no run found". Now polls every 30s
(up to 15 min) for the E2E run to complete before checking the result.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git push -u origin fix/release-gate-wait-for-e2e 2>&1

## Summary
- The release-please PR opens before E2E tests finish on the same `main` push, causing the release gate to immediately fail with "no run found"
- Now polls every 30s (up to 15 min) for the E2E run to complete before checking the result
- Added `timeout-minutes: 20` job safety net

## Test plan
- [ ] Next release-please PR should show the gate waiting for E2E instead of failing immediately

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)"

PR created: https://github.com/FSM1/cipher-box/pull/252

The gate now polls every 30s for up to 15 minutes, waiting for the E2E run to finish before checking its conclusion. The `conclusion` field from the GitHub API is empty while a run is in progress and only populated once it completes, so the poll loop naturally handles the timing.

message.content: Would it be possible to add a `detect-changes` step that determines the changes between the previous version tag and the current one being created, and based on that, determines whether the desktop-e2e tests need to be checked, rather than just checking based on whether the latest commit to main has a desktop-e2e run.

content.thinking:
The user wants a smarter approach to detecting whether desktop E2E tests need to be checked. Instead of just looking at whether the latest main commit has a desktop E2E run, they want to look at what files changed between the previous release tag and the current commit, and based on that determine if desktop-related code was touched.

Let me think about this:

1. We need to find the previous version tag
2. Compare the diff between that tag and the current main SHA
3. If desktop-related files changed (e.g., `apps/desktop/`, `packages/` that desktop depends on, Tauri config, etc.), then we require desktop E2E to pass


4. If only web/API/docs changed, we can skip the desktop E2E check

1→name: Desktop E2E Tests
     2→

     4→  workflow_run:
     5→    workflows: ['CI']
     6→    types: [completed]

    10→permissions:

    12→  pull-requests: read
    13→
    14→jobs:
    15→  changes:
    16→    name: Detect Changes
    17→    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    18→    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    19→    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    20→    outputs:

    22→    steps:

   154→      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
   155→        with:
   156→          node-version: '22'
   157→          cache: 'pnpm'
   158→
   159→      - name: Install dependencies
   160→        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
   161→
   162→      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---
   163→
   164→      - name: Build desktop frontend
   165→        run: |
   166→          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
   167→          cd apps/desktop
   168→          pnpm vite build
   169→        env:
   170→          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
   171→          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
   172→
   173→      # --- Build debug binary ---
   174→
   175→      - name: Install Rust toolchain
   176→        run: rustup default stable
   177→
   178→      - uses: actions/cache@v4
   179→        with:
   180→          path: |
   181→            ~/.cargo/registry
   182→            ~/.cargo/git
   183→            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
   184→          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
   185→          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-
   186→
   187→      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
   188→        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
   189→        shell: powershell
   190→        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"
   191→
   192→      - name: Build debug binary
   193→        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
   194→        env:
   195→          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
   196→
   197→      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
   198→        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
   199→        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true
   200→
   201→      # --- Install backend services ---
   202→
   203→      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
   204→        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
   205→        with:
   206→          username: postgres
   207→          password: postgres

   209→          postgres-version: '16'
   210→        id: postgres
   211→
   212→      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
   213→        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
   214→        run: |
   215→          brew install kubo
   216→          ipfs init

   224→          done
   225→
   226→      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)

   263→      - name: Install Redis (macOS)

   268→

file.content:
name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Resolve parent commit SHA
        id: parent
        run: echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          base: ${{ steps.parent.outputs.sha }}
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow
          # Verify WinFsp installed and add bin to PATH for DLL discovery
          $winfspDir = (Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\WinFsp" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).InstallDir
          if ($winfspDir) {
            Write-Host "WinFsp installed at: $winfspDir"
            $binDir = Join-Path $winfspDir "bin"
            Write-Host "Adding to PATH: $binDir"
            echo "$binDir" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append
          } else {
            Write-Host "WARNING: WinFsp registry key not found after install"
          }

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install memurai-developer -y --no-progress
          # Memurai installs as a Windows service and starts automatically
          $svc = Get-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($svc -and $svc.Status -eq "Running") {
            Write-Host "Memurai service is running"
          } else {
            # Fallback: start service manually
            Start-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
          }
          # Verify Redis is responding
          $env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine") + ";" + $env:PATH
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) {
            try {
              $result = & redis-cli ping 2>$null
              if ($result -eq "PONG") { $ready = $true; break }
            } catch {}
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
          if ($ready) { Write-Host "Redis (Memurai) ready" } else { Write-Host "WARNING: Redis may not be ready" }

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost

      - name: Create desktop .env

          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness

            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379

          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd apps/api

          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then

              break
            fi

        env:

          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh

          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Start frontend dev server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          npx vite preview --port 1420 &
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          BINARY="apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          LOGFILE="$RUNNER_TEMP/cipherbox-desktop.log"
          "$BINARY" --dev-key "$DEV_KEY" > "$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          powershell -File "$PWD/tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.ps1"
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
          cat "$LOGFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
            /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/cipherbox-desktop.log
          retention-days: 7

name: Release Gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  verify-e2e:
    name: Verify E2E Passed
    # Only run on release-please PRs
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Wait for E2E tests and verify they passed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get the latest commit on main (the base the release PR targets)
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Latest main commit: ${MAIN_SHA}"

          # Poll for the Web E2E run to complete (it triggers on the same push)
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=30
          POLL_INTERVAL=30
          echo "Waiting for Web E2E run to complete (polling every ${POLL_INTERVAL}s, max ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts)..."

          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            E2E_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
              --workflow=e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
              --json headSha,conclusion,status \
              --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion")

            if [ -n "$E2E_CONCLUSION" ]; then
              echo "Web E2E completed with conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION}"
              break
            fi

            if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
              echo "::error::Web E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes for main (${MAIN_SHA})."
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
            sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
          done

          if [ "$E2E_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION})"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Web E2E: passed"

          # Desktop E2E — block only if it ran and failed
          DESKTOP_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
            --json headSha,conclusion \
            --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion")

          if [ -n "$DESKTOP_CONCLUSION" ] && [ "$DESKTOP_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::Desktop E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${DESKTOP_CONCLUSION})"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$DESKTOP_CONCLUSION" ]; then
            echo "Desktop E2E: no run for this commit (skipped)"
          else
            echo "Desktop E2E: passed"
          fi

          echo "All E2E gates passed — release is safe to merge."

name: Release Gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes Since Last Release
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.check.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check for desktop-related changes since last release
        id: check
        run: |
          # Find the latest non-staging release tag
          PREV_TAG=$(git tag --list 'v*' --sort=-v:refname \
            | grep -v 'staging' \
            | head -1)

          if [ -z "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
            echo "No previous release tag found — assuming desktop changed"
            echo "desktop=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Previous release tag: ${PREV_TAG}"
          echo "Diffing ${PREV_TAG}..HEAD"

          # Desktop-related path patterns (mirrored from e2e-desktop.yml)
          DESKTOP_PATTERNS=(
            'apps/desktop/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
            'apps/desktop/index.html'
            'apps/desktop/vite.config.'
            'apps/desktop/tsconfig'
            'packages/crypto/src/'
            'packages/crypto/tsconfig'
            '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'
          )

          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only "${PREV_TAG}..HEAD")
          DESKTOP_CHANGED=false

          for pattern in "${DESKTOP_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
            if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "$pattern"; then
              echo "Desktop change detected matching pattern: ${pattern}"
              DESKTOP_CHANGED=true
              break
            fi
          done

          echo "desktop=${DESKTOP_CHANGED}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Desktop changes detected: ${DESKTOP_CHANGED}"

  verify-e2e:
    name: Verify E2E Passed
    needs: detect-changes
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Wait for Web E2E and verify it passed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get the latest commit on main (the base the release PR targets)
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Latest main commit: ${MAIN_SHA}"

          # Poll for the Web E2E run to complete (it triggers on the same push)
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=30
          POLL_INTERVAL=30
          echo "Waiting for Web E2E run to complete (polling every ${POLL_INTERVAL}s, max ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts)..."

          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            E2E_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
              --workflow=e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
              --json headSha,conclusion,status \
              --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion")

            if [ -n "$E2E_CONCLUSION" ]; then
              echo "Web E2E completed with conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION}"
              break
            fi

            if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
              echo "::error::Web E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes for main (${MAIN_SHA})."
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
            sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
          done

          if [ "$E2E_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION})"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Web E2E: passed"

      - name: Check Desktop E2E (if desktop changed)
        if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Desktop changes detected — verifying Desktop E2E"

          # Poll for Desktop E2E to complete (it chains off CI, so starts later)
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=40
          POLL_INTERVAL=30
          echo "Waiting for Desktop E2E run to complete (polling every ${POLL_INTERVAL}s, max ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts)..."

          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            DESKTOP_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
              --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
              --json headSha,conclusion,status \
              --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion")

            if [ -n "$DESKTOP_CONCLUSION" ]; then
              echo "Desktop E2E completed with conclusion: ${DESKTOP_CONCLUSION}"
              break
            fi

name: Release Gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes Since Last Release
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.check.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check for desktop-related changes since last release
        id: check
        run: |
          # Find the latest non-staging release tag
          PREV_TAG=$(git tag --list 'v*' --sort=-v:refname \
            | grep -v 'staging' \
            | head -1)

          if [ -z "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
            echo "No previous release tag found — assuming desktop changed"
            echo "desktop=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Previous release tag: ${PREV_TAG}"
          echo "Diffing ${PREV_TAG}..HEAD"

          # Desktop-related path patterns (mirrored from e2e-desktop.yml)
          DESKTOP_PATTERNS=(
            'apps/desktop/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
            'apps/desktop/index.html'
            'apps/desktop/vite.config.'
            'apps/desktop/tsconfig'
            'packages/crypto/src/'
            'packages/crypto/tsconfig'
            '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'
          )

          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only "${PREV_TAG}..HEAD")
          DESKTOP_CHANGED=false

          for pattern in "${DESKTOP_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
            if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "$pattern"; then
              echo "Desktop change detected matching pattern: ${pattern}"
              DESKTOP_CHANGED=true
              break
            fi
          done

          echo "desktop=${DESKTOP_CHANGED}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Desktop changes detected: ${DESKTOP_CHANGED}"

  verify-e2e:
    name: Verify E2E Passed
    needs: detect-changes
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Wait for Web E2E and verify it passed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get the latest commit on main (the base the release PR targets)
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Latest main commit: ${MAIN_SHA}"

          # Poll for the Web E2E run to complete (it triggers on the same push)
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=30
          POLL_INTERVAL=30
          echo "Waiting for Web E2E run to complete (polling every ${POLL_INTERVAL}s, max ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts)..."

          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            E2E_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
              --workflow=e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
              --json headSha,conclusion,status \
              --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion")

            sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
          done

          if [ "$E2E_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION})"

          echo "Desktop changes detected — verifying Desktop E2E"

          # Poll for Desktop E2E to complete (it chains off CI, so starts later)
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=40
          POLL_INTERVAL=30
          echo "Waiting for Desktop E2E run to complete (polling every ${POLL_INTERVAL}s, max ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts)..."

          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            DESKTOP_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
              --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
              --json headSha,conclusion,status \

            if [ -n "$DESKTOP_CONCLUSION" ]; then
              echo "Desktop E2E completed with conclusion: ${DESKTOP_CONCLUSION}"
              break

              echo "::error::Desktop E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes for main (${MAIN_SHA})."
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: Desktop E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
            sleep $POLL_INTERVAL

      - name: Skip Desktop E2E (no desktop changes)
        if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop != 'true'
        run: echo "No desktop-related changes since last release — skipping Desktop E2E gate"

      - name: Summary
        run: echo "All E2E gates passed — release is safe to merge."

content.text:
Looks good. Key design decisions:

- **`detect-changes` job**: Checks out with `fetch-depth: 0` to get full history, finds the latest non-staging release tag, and diffs against HEAD using the same path patterns from `e2e-desktop.yml`
- **Desktop E2E poll**: When desktop changes are detected, it polls with more attempts (40 x 30s = 20 min) since desktop E2E chains off CI and starts later
- **No desktop changes**: Cleanly skips the desktop gate with a log message

Instead of checking whether the latest main commit has a desktop E2E
run, diff changed files between the previous release tag and HEAD
against desktop-related path patterns (mirrored from e2e-desktop.yml).
Only require desktop E2E to pass when desktop code actually changed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git push 2>&1

The user is raising two points:

1. **Desktop E2E gap**: The release gate detects that desktop code changed since the last release (across multiple commits), so it expects desktop E2E to have passed. But the desktop E2E workflow (`e2e-desktop.yml`) only runs per-commit based on that specific commit's changes. If the last commit to main didn't touch desktop code, there's no desktop E2E run for that HEAD SHA — even though desktop code changed in an earlier commit. The release gate would poll forever and time out.

2. **Redundant CI on main push**: The CI workflow runs on both `pull_request` and `push` to main. 

For the first issue, I could either have the release gate look back through recent commits to find the most recent successful desktop E2E run instead of just checking HEAD, or I could modify the push-to-main workflow to always run desktop E2E when desktop code has changed since the last release. The second approach seems cleaner — removing the `push` trigger from CI entirely and having the main push workflow conditionally run desktop E2E based on what actually changed. solving point 2 simultaneously)

For point 2: The user wants:
- Remove `push: branches: [main]` from `ci.yml`
- Create/modify a post-merge workflow on main that runs web E2E (always) and desktop E2E (conditional on change scope)

Actually, looking at the current setup:
- `ci.yml` runs on push to main AND on PRs
- `e2e.yml` runs on push to main
- `e2e-desktop.yml` runs via `workflow_run` after CI completes on main, with its own change detection

The user's desired state:
- `ci.yml` only runs on PRs (remove push trigger)
- A post-merge workflow on `push` to main that:
  - Always runs web E2E
  - Conditionally runs desktop E2E based on change scope

This would also fix point 1, since the desktop E2E would trigger when desktop code changes, letting the release gate check for it. But there's a catch—the desktop E2E currently chains off CI via `workflow_run`, so removing CI from push-to-main would break that trigger. I need to create a new post-merge workflow that handles change detection and runs both web E2E unconditionally and desktop E2E only when desktop paths changed, then either update `e2e-desktop.yml` to support being triggered by this new workflow or fold it into the new one.

Actually, a simpler approach might be to remove the `push` trigger from `ci.yml`, keep `e2e.yml` as-is, and modify `e2e-desktop.yml` to trigger directly on `push` to main with its own change detection instead of chaining off CI. But then I hit another issue—if multiple commits land between releases and only some touch desktop code, the HEAD commit might not have a desktop E2E run, which breaks the release gate's detection logic.

The real fix is to have the release gate find the most recent successful desktop E2E run for any commit after the last release tag, rather than requiring one at HEAD specifically. That way, if desktop code changed anywhere in the range since the last release and ran successfully, the gate can proceed—accounting for cases where the latest commit didn't touch desktop but an earlier one did.

For the implementation, I need to update the workflow triggers: remove the push trigger from the CI workflow, keep the web E2E as-is on every push to main, and modify the desktop E2E to run on push with its own change detection logic instead of chaining off CI. content.text:
Good catch on the gap. Let me think through both issues together.

**The desktop E2E problem**: The release gate diffs `last-tag..HEAD` and finds desktop changes from 3 commits ago — but the desktop E2E only ran on that specific commit's SHA, not on HEAD. Polling for a desktop E2E run at HEAD would time out.

**The redundant CI problem**: CI already ran on the PR, running it again on push to main is wasted compute.

The solution is:
1. Remove `push` trigger from CI
2. Make both E2E workflows trigger directly on push to main (desktop with change detection)
3. In the release gate, find the **most recent successful** desktop E2E run after the last release tag (not necessarily at HEAD)

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

          files: desktop-lcov.info
          flags: desktop
          fail_ci_if_error: false

          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-check-windows:
    name: Cargo Check (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with winfsp feature
        run: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-check-macos:
    name: Cargo Check (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-check-linux:
    name: Cargo Check (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

  cargo-test-windows:
    name: Cargo Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-windows]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-windows.result == 'success'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-test-macos:
    name: Cargo Test (macOS)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-macos]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-macos.result == 'success'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          # fuser's build.rs looks for fuse.pc; FUSE-T ships fuse-t.pc
          # Copy instead of symlink to avoid dangling link if path varies
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Found fuse-t.pc at: $FUSE_T_PC"
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          # FUSE-T reports its product version (1.x) but implements the FUSE 2.9 API.
          # fuser's build.rs requires fuse >= 2.6.0, so fix the version to match.
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-test-linux:
    name: Cargo Test + Coverage (Linux)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-linux]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-linux.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        run: |
          rustup component add llvm-tools-preview
          cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked

      - name: Run Rust tests with coverage
        run: >-
          cargo llvm-cov
          --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
          --no-default-features --features fuse
          --lcov --output-path desktop-lcov.info

      - name: Upload desktop coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: desktop-lcov.info
          flags: desktop
          fail_ci_if_error: false

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Resolve parent commit SHA
        id: parent
        run: echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          base: ${{ steps.parent.outputs.sha }}
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow
          # Verify WinFsp installed and add bin to PATH for DLL discovery
          $winfspDir = (Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\WinFsp" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).InstallDir
          if ($winfspDir) {
            Write-Host "WinFsp installed at: $winfspDir"
            $binDir = Join-Path $winfspDir "bin"
            Write-Host "Adding to PATH: $binDir"
            echo "$binDir" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append
          } else {
            Write-Host "WARNING: WinFsp registry key not found after install"
          }

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install memurai-developer -y --no-progress
          # Memurai installs as a Windows service and starts automatically
          $svc = Get-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($svc -and $svc.Status -eq "Running") {
            Write-Host "Memurai service is running"
          } else {
            # Fallback: start service manually
            Start-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
          }
          # Verify Redis is responding
          $env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine") + ";" + $env:PATH
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) {
            try {
              $result = & redis-cli ping 2>$null
              if ($result -eq "PONG") { $ready = $true; break }
            } catch {}
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
          if ($ready) { Write-Host "Redis (Memurai) ready" } else { Write-Host "WARNING: Redis may not be ready" }

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2

        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432

          DB_PASSWORD: postgres

          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key

          LOGFILE="$RUNNER_TEMP/cipherbox-desktop.log"

          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          powershell -File "$PWD/tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.ps1"
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
          cat "$LOGFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
            /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/cipherbox-desktop.log
          retention-days: 7
