name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Resolve parent commit SHA
        id: parent
        run: echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          base: ${{ steps.parent.outputs.sha }}
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow
          # Verify WinFsp installed and add bin to PATH for DLL discovery
          $winfspDir = (Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\WinFsp" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).InstallDir
          if ($winfspDir) {
            Write-Host "WinFsp installed at: $winfspDir"
            $binDir = Join-Path $winfspDir "bin"
            Write-Host "Adding to PATH: $binDir"
            echo "$binDir" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append
          } else {
            Write-Host "WARNING: WinFsp registry key not found after install"
          }

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install memurai-developer -y --no-progress
          # Memurai installs as a Windows service and starts automatically
          $svc = Get-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($svc -and $svc.Status -eq "Running") {
            Write-Host "Memurai service is running"
          } else {
            # Fallback: start service manually
            Start-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
          }
          # Verify Redis is responding
          $env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine") + ";" + $env:PATH
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) {
            try {
              $result = & redis-cli ping 2>$null
              if ($result -eq "PONG") { $ready = $true; break }
            } catch {}
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
          if ($ready) { Write-Host "Redis (Memurai) ready" } else { Write-Host "WARNING: Redis may not be ready" }

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Start frontend dev server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite preview --port 1420 &
          # Wait for dev server
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Resolve parent commit SHA
        id: parent
        run: echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          base: ${{ steps.parent.outputs.sha }}
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow
          # Verify WinFsp installed and add bin to PATH for DLL discovery
          $winfspDir = (Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\WinFsp" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).InstallDir
          if ($winfspDir) {
            Write-Host "WinFsp installed at: $winfspDir"
            $binDir = Join-Path $winfspDir "bin"
            Write-Host "Adding to PATH: $binDir"
            echo "$binDir" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append
          } else {
            Write-Host "WARNING: WinFsp registry key not found after install"
          }

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install memurai-developer -y --no-progress
          # Memurai installs as a Windows service and starts automatically
          $svc = Get-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($svc -and $svc.Status -eq "Running") {
            Write-Host "Memurai service is running"
          } else {
            # Fallback: start service manually
            Start-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
          }
          # Verify Redis is responding
          $env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine") + ";" + $env:PATH
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) {
            try {
              $result = & redis-cli ping 2>$null
              if ($result -eq "PONG") { $ready = $true; break }
            } catch {}
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
          if ($ready) { Write-Host "Redis (Memurai) ready" } else { Write-Host "WARNING: Redis may not be ready" }

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local

          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost

          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server

            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then

              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Resolve parent commit SHA
        id: parent
        run: echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          base: ${{ steps.parent.outputs.sha }}
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow
          # Verify WinFsp installed and add bin to PATH for DLL discovery
          $winfspDir = (Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\WinFsp" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).InstallDir
          if ($winfspDir) {
            Write-Host "WinFsp installed at: $winfspDir"
            $binDir = Join-Path $winfspDir "bin"
            Write-Host "Adding to PATH: $binDir"
            echo "$binDir" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append
          } else {
            Write-Host "WARNING: WinFsp registry key not found after install"
          }

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install memurai-developer -y --no-progress
          # Memurai installs as a Windows service and starts automatically
          $svc = Get-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($svc -and $svc.Status -eq "Running") {
            Write-Host "Memurai service is running"
          } else {
            # Fallback: start service manually
            Start-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
          }
          # Verify Redis is responding
          $env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine") + ";" + $env:PATH
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) {
            try {
              $result = & redis-cli ping 2>$null
              if ($result -eq "PONG") { $ready = $true; break }
            } catch {}
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
          if ($ready) { Write-Host "Redis (Memurai) ready" } else { Write-Host "WARNING: Redis may not be ready" }

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Start frontend dev server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite preview --port 1420 &
          # Wait for dev server
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info
          DISPLAY: ':99'
          WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER: '1'
        run: |
          Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 &
          sleep 1
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Start frontend dev server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          npx vite preview --port 1420 &
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          BINARY="apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          LOGFILE="$RUNNER_TEMP/cipherbox-desktop.log"
          "$BINARY" --dev-key "$DEV_KEY" > "$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          powershell -File "$PWD/tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.ps1"
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
          cat "$LOGFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
            /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/cipherbox-desktop.log
          retention-days: 7

lines: # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

content.text: Now update the release gate. The key change: for desktop E2E, find the most recent successful run on main since the last tag, not necessarily at HEAD.

input.content:
name: Release Gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes Since Last Release
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.check.outputs.desktop }}
      prev_tag: ${{ steps.check.outputs.prev_tag }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check for desktop-related changes since last release
        id: check
        run: |
          # Find the latest non-staging release tag
          PREV_TAG=$(git tag --list 'v*' --sort=-v:refname \
            | grep -v 'staging' \
            | head -1)

          if [ -z "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
            echo "No previous release tag found — assuming desktop changed"
            echo "desktop=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "prev_tag=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Previous release tag: ${PREV_TAG}"
          echo "prev_tag=${PREV_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Diffing ${PREV_TAG}..HEAD"

          # Desktop-related path patterns (mirrored from e2e-desktop.yml)
          DESKTOP_PATTERNS=(
            'apps/desktop/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
            'apps/desktop/index.html'
            'apps/desktop/vite.config.'
            'apps/desktop/tsconfig'
            'packages/crypto/src/'
            'packages/crypto/tsconfig'
            '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'
          )

          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only "${PREV_TAG}..HEAD")
          DESKTOP_CHANGED=false

          for pattern in "${DESKTOP_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
            if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "$pattern"; then
              echo "Desktop change detected matching pattern: ${pattern}"
              DESKTOP_CHANGED=true
              break
            fi
          done

          echo "desktop=${DESKTOP_CHANGED}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Desktop changes detected: ${DESKTOP_CHANGED}"

  verify-e2e:
    name: Verify E2E Passed
    needs: detect-changes
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Wait for Web E2E and verify it passed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get the latest commit on main (the base the release PR targets)
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Latest main commit: ${MAIN_SHA}"

          # Poll for the Web E2E run to complete (it triggers on the same push)
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=30
          POLL_INTERVAL=30
          echo "Waiting for Web E2E run to complete (polling every ${POLL_INTERVAL}s, max ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts)..."

          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            E2E_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
              --workflow=e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
              --json headSha,conclusion,status \
              --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion")

            if [ -n "$E2E_CONCLUSION" ]; then
              echo "Web E2E completed with conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION}"
              break
            fi

            if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
              echo "::error::Web E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes for main (${MAIN_SHA})."
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
            sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
          done

          if [ "$E2E_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION})"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Web E2E: passed"

      - name: Verify Desktop E2E (if desktop changed)
        if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PREV_TAG: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.prev_tag }}
        run: |
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Desktop changes detected since ${PREV_TAG} — verifying Desktop E2E"

          # First check if there's a desktop E2E run for HEAD (may still be running)
          HEAD_STATUS=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=5 \
            --json headSha,conclusion,status \
            --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].status")

          if [ -n "$HEAD_STATUS" ]; then
            echo "Desktop E2E run exists for HEAD — polling until complete..."
            MAX_ATTEMPTS=40
            POLL_INTERVAL=30

            for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
              CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
                --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=5 \
                --json headSha,conclusion,status \
                --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion")

              if [ -n "$CONCLUSION" ]; then
                if [ "$CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
                  echo "::error::Desktop E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${CONCLUSION})"
                  exit 1
                fi
                echo "Desktop E2E: passed (at HEAD)"
                exit 0
              fi

              if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: |
          pnpm eslint --fix apps/web/src/api/ || true
          pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/openapi.json || (echo "OpenAPI spec is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)
          git diff --exit-code apps/web/src/api/ || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run API tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-check-windows:
    name: Cargo Check (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with winfsp feature
        run: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-check-macos:
    name: Cargo Check (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-check-linux:
    name: Cargo Check (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

  cargo-test-windows:
    name: Cargo Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-windows]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-windows.result == 'success'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-test-macos:
    name: Cargo Test (macOS)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-macos]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-macos.result == 'success'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          # fuser's build.rs looks for fuse.pc; FUSE-T ships fuse-t.pc
          # Copy instead of symlink to avoid dangling link if path varies
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Found fuse-t.pc at: $FUSE_T_PC"
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          # FUSE-T reports its product version (1.x) but implements the FUSE 2.9 API.
          # fuser's build.rs requires fuse >= 2.6.0, so fix the version to match.
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-test-linux:
    name: Cargo Test + Coverage (Linux)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-linux]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-linux.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        run: |
          rustup component add llvm-tools-preview
          cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked

      - name: Run Rust tests with coverage
        run: >-
          cargo llvm-cov
          --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
          --no-default-features --features fuse
          --lcov --output-path desktop-lcov.info

      - name: Upload desktop coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: desktop-lcov.info
          flags: desktop
          fail_ci_if_error: false

content.text:
Pushed to PR #252. Here's a summary of the three changes:

**`ci.yml`** — Removed `push: branches: [main]` trigger and all `event_name == 'push'` bypass conditions. CI now only runs on PRs.

**`e2e-desktop.yml`** — Changed from `workflow_run` (chaining off CI) to `push: branches: [main]` with its own change detection. No longer waits for CI to finish first (CI already passed on the PR before merge).

**`release-gate.yml`** — Desktop E2E verification now handles two cases:
1. **HEAD triggered desktop E2E** (HEAD touched desktop code) → polls until that run completes
2. **HEAD didn't trigger desktop E2E** (desktop changed in an earlier commit) → finds the most recent successful desktop E2E run within the `last-tag..HEAD` range using the GitHub compare API

content.content:
# CodeRabbit Review Feedback

**Nitpick Comment Summary:**

CodeRabbit identified a potential race condition in the Desktop E2E gate logic. The bot noted that unlike the Web E2E check (which now polls), the Desktop E2E section doesn't implement polling and could incorrectly treat in-progress runs as "skipped."

**Full Comment Text:**

> "The Desktop E2E check doesn't implement polling. If the Desktop workflow is still running when this check executes, `DESKTOP_CONCLUSION` will be empty (since `conclusion` is null for in-progress runs), and it will be treated as 'no run for this commit (skipped)' rather than waiting for the result."

The reviewer suggested two remedies:
1. Add similar polling logic to Desktop E2E if it should be a hard gate
2. Add clarifying comments if the current "fail-fast only" behavior is intentional

**Context:** This feedback was addressing lines 55-69 in `.github/workflows/release-gate.yml`, where the Desktop E2E gate reads conclusion values without retry logic.
